title: Clean thread-safe atomic counter using threading.Lock context manager
diff:
@@ -1,3 +1,19 @@
+import threading
+
 class AtomicCounter:
+    """Thread-safe integer counter protected by a lock."""
+
     def __init__(self, initial_value: int = 0) -> None:
+        self._lock = threading.Lock()
         self._count = initial_value
+
+    def increment(self, step: int = 1) -> int:
+        """Atomically increment the counter and return the updated value."""
+        with self._lock:
+            self._count += step
+            return self._count
+
+    @property
+    def value(self) -> int:
+        with self._lock:
+            return self._count
